scope: Complete visual inspection of every page in the cumulative Indonesian PDF through Unit 16 after the Unit 15 determinant-comparison reflow.

render_evidence.inventory_digest_method: SHA-256 over UTF-8, filename|bytes|sha256 per sorted line, final LF
render_evidence.inspection: All original contact sheets covering pages 1-261 were inspected. Because sheet-08 previewed as nearly blank after aggressive downsampling, readable split sheets 08a and 08b were generated and inspected for pages 211-225 and 226-240. Full-resolution renders 211, 220, 231, 232, and 240 were additionally inspected. The original sheet-08 bytes were valid; the blank appearance was a preview artifact.

focused_reflow_evidence.finding: The split determinant comparison on page 231 and aligned determinant identities on page 232 are legible, centered, and wholly inside the text block.

limitations: This is a visual-rendering receipt, not a claim that the PDF is structurally tagged; the structural receipt records the untagged-PDF limitation separately.
The bound TeX logs contain non-blocking box diagnostics, while independent page-bound, body-extent, full-render, and visual checks pass.
Hollow square marks visible in the reader are intentional proof-ending marks, not missing-glyph placeholders.
